create_LocalizedBoxMotionBlurTransform: create a LocalizedBoxMotionBlurTransform to apply motion blur to specific bounding box regions in an image
build_LocalizedBoxMotionBlur_augmentatio: build a LocalizedBoxMotionBlur augmentation that randomly applies motion blur to annotated bounding boxes with configurable probability
create_MotionBlurTransform: create a MotionBlurTransform to apply full-image motion blur with configurable kernel size, angle, and direction parameters
build_RandomMotionBlur_augmentation: build a RandomMotionBlur augmentation that probabilistically applies random motion blur to an entire image
create_GaussianBlurTransform: create a GaussianBlurTransform to apply Gaussian blur to an image using cv2 with configurable kernel size and sigma range
